title: Hearty Garlic Algerian Cheese Flatbread
description: A garlicky, cheese‑pull flatbread with an Algerian twist, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add water and olive oil and stir until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into two equal portions and roll each into a flat circle on a floured surface.
Heat a comal over medium heat and place the dough on it.
Cook each side for 3 minutes or until golden brown and puffy.
Remove the flatbread from the comal and spread minced garlic on one side of each.
Sprinkle shredded vegan cheese evenly over the garlic.
Return the flatbread to the comal and cover for 2 minutes to melt the cheese.
Flip and cook the other side for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a squeeze of unwaxed lime zest.
